_about: National elections from 1945 in about 40 countries, from each election article's infobox (cited per record): poll date (the last day of the main polling; rounds lists every polling day), winner and party, the incumbent before, outcome (incumbent_held, party_held, changed), turnout and the leading candidates. The record's moment (date, time, tz_east, place) is the swearing-in of the head of government or state that followed, when oath_known is true; oath_source says where that date comes from (Wikidata term start, Wikidata cabinet inception, or the constitution's fixed inauguration day). When the oath is unknown the moment is the poll date, cast at local noon. Oath times are given only where documented (US and Philippine noon inaugurations by constitution; Indian ceremonies from official notices).
